name: Marryk Nurribit
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Marryk Nurribit teaches young gnomes the first steps in arcane magic. Local brews often draw his attention from lessons, and he asks pupils for spare coins to buy a drink.

sections.title: Arcane Studies and Ale
sections.body: Every newly arrived gnome mage in Coldridge Valley starts out as Marryk's pupil. Yet a flagon of dwarven ale can win more of his attention than a lesson. He asks new pupils for spare pocket change, and warns aspiring spellcasters about Gnomeregan's radioactive, trogg-infested ruins beyond Coldridge Valley.

faq.answer: Marryk Nurribit teaches gnomes the fundamentals of arcane magic at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh. He trains newly arrived gnome mages.

faq.q: Why does Marryk keep asking for money for beer?
aliases: why does he ask for coins
faq.answer: Marryk enjoys local spirits and often asks his students for spare change to buy beer at the tavern.

faq.q: What does Marryk say about Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Marryk warns new mages not to underestimate the dangers in Gnomeregan's irradiated ruins.

angles.text: As a gnome mage starting out in Coldridge Valley, you turn to Marryk for your first spells and your Glyphic Memorandum.
As a gnome taking shelter in Dun Morogh, you know Marryk as a scholar who has taken readily to dwarven tavern life.
